limitations: Host adapters are contract-tested until E10 supplies qualifying real-host receipts.
Symlink creation may be unavailable on Windows without developer mode or elevated rights; fail-closed rejection is still required when a symlink exists.
WSL is exercised as a Linux compatibility fixture; it is not reported as a separate hosted operating-system receipt.
Package-manager adapters are outside the support boundary until they verify canonical release hashes and invoke this lifecycle contract.
